question: Is the TRT magic parameter Lambda = 3/16 actually the wall-position-optimal, viscosity-robust choice for half-way bounce-back walls in this repository's D2Q9 TRT kernel, and where do the other entries of the magic-Lambda table (1/12, 1/6, 1/4, 3/8) land on the wall-position error?

benchmark.case: body-force plane Poiseuille, pre-streaming half-way bounce-back walls, x-periodic
benchmark.grid: nx=4 (periodic, no resolution study in x), ny=H+2, H=32 (main) / 16,64 (resolution check)
benchmark.observable: delta_eff = H_eff - H with H_eff = (12 nu Q / g)^(1/3) from the measured flux (no profile fit)
benchmark.reference: u(y)=g/(2nu)(y-1/2)(H+1/2-y), Q=g H^3/(12 nu) (White, Viscous Fluid Flow 3rd ed. sec. 3-2)

kpis.P1: delta_eff(Lambda, tau) map in cells, H=32
kpis.P2: tau-spread of delta_eff at fixed Lambda: max_tau |delta_eff - mean_tau delta_eff|
kpis.P3: profile L2 relative error vs analytic parabola
kpis.P4: TRT( tau, Lambda=(tau-1/2)^2 ) vs BGK(tau) pointwise max |du| (identity gate)
kpis.P5: delta_eff resolution dependence for Lambda=3/16 and 1/4 at H=16/32/64
kpis.P6: Lambda_target=0.075 (the method_selection re-derivation for tau_minus=2.0 at tau=0.55) vs Lambda=3/16 head-to-head at tau=0.55

hypotheses_with_thresholds.H1_magic_is_flat: at Lambda=3/16, P2 <= 1/5 * P2(Lambda=1/4) AND max_tau |delta_eff| <= 0.03 cell (flag: pass/fail)
hypotheses_with_thresholds.H2_deviation_costs: monotone growth of |delta_eff| with |Lambda - 3/16| at fixed tau=0.80 (LOWEST |Lambda-3/16| -> smallest |delta_eff|), checked over the 5 tabulated Lambdas
hypotheses_with_thresholds.H3_bgk_identity: P4 <= 1e-13 (machine-precision identity: TRT with Lambda=(tau-1/2)^2 IS BGK)
hypotheses_with_thresholds.H4_optimal_Lambda: argmin over the scanned Lambda grid of |delta_eff| at tau=0.80 equals 3/16
hypotheses_with_thresholds.H5_accuracy_band: profile L2 (P3) <= 3% for all scanned (Lambda, tau) (tighter than the owner 15% band; declared before the run)

falsification_rule: any hypothesis whose threshold is missed is reported as FAIL with its measured number; thresholds are not edited after the run. A FAIL on H1/H2/H4 does not invalidate the measurement - it becomes the finding.
not_covered: unsteady or high-Re channel flow (steady laminar only)
D3Q27 flow-side TRT (R1 left it open; still open here)
any statement about the OSS reference binary - this round is analytic-reference only
